name: Memphis and its Necropolis – the Pyramid Fields from Giza to Dahshur
description: Memphis was the capital of Egypt's Old Kingdom, and today its ruins lie just south of Cairo along the Nile. Stretching from Giza to Dahshur, the surrounding desert is dotted with pyramids, rock-cut tombs, richly decorated mastabas and temples built for the kingdom's rulers and elite. In ancient times, the site was counted among the Seven Wonders of the World.
